# Client test fixtures

- `workspace/`: copy of the `mini`, `mini_inc`, `mini_bat`, `mini_err` families from
  `server/tests/fixtures` (self-written models; outputs generated by GAMS 54.6.1, paths rewritten to
  `/work`, license and machine lines replaced by placeholders; see the README there), plus `cplex.opt` and `bad/cplex.opt`. The
  integration runner copies this directory to a temp dir and rewrites `/work` in the `.ref` files.
- `gdxdiff/`: `a.gdx`/`b.gdx` written by `server/crates/gams-gdx/examples/write_pair.rs` (pure Rust writer);
  `diff.gdx` and `gdxdiff.stdout.txt` are the output of `gdxdiff a.gdx b.gdx diff.gdx` of GAMS 54.6.1
  (license-free tool); `diff.symbols.json` is the `gams/gdxSymbols` response for `diff.gdx`.
